ViGoR-Bench: How Far Are Visual Generative Models From Zero-Shot Visual Reasoners?









	
		
	
	
		🔍 Overview
	

ViGoR-Bench (Vision-Generative Reasoning-centric Benchmark) is a unified evaluation framework designed to stress-test the reasoning capabilities of visual generative models. Beneath the stunning visual fidelity of modern AIGC models lies a logical desert — systems frequently fail tasks requiring physical, causal, or complex spatial reasoning.
